caption: The shebang tells the system to run this with bash; $NAME reads a variable back.

steps.label: if ... fi
steps.sub: run a block only when a condition is true

steps.label: for ... done
steps.sub: repeat a block once per item in a list

code:
#!/bin/bash
SERVICE="nginx"

if systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE"; then
  echo "$SERVICE is running"
else
  echo "$SERVICE is NOT running"
fi

for LOGFILE in /var/log/syslog /var/log/auth.log; do
  tail -n 5 "$LOGFILE"
done
